name: Lights of December Parade
address: 15th St and Walnut St, Boulder, CO 80302
paras: Downtown Boulder Community Initiatives presents the Lights of December Parade on Saturday, December 12, 2026, starting at 6 PM. Floats are created and decorated by local businesses, churches, schools, community groups and nonprofits, and the grand finale is an appearance by Santa Claus.

The route starts at 15th and Walnut streets, heads west to Broadway, north on Broadway, east on Spruce and finishes at 15th and Spruce. The reviewing stand is at Broadway and Pearl, and spectators are asked to stay behind the fencing. The host lists no admission price.
tip: Claim a spot behind the fencing near Broadway and Pearl early and bring warm layers for the 6 PM start.
